subject: The secret scanning mistake 90% of users make
preview_text: You're probably using the app wrong. This one change makes it 10x more accurate. I wasn't going to share this.
body_paragraphs: I need to confess something. For months, I watched users scan single messages and get frustrated when the AI missed patterns. They'd say 'it didn't catch the manipulation' or 'the toxicity score felt off.' And every time, I knew exactly why.

Here's the truth: scanning isolated texts is like trying to diagnose a fever with one sneeze. Toxic patterns don't live in single messages—they unfold across conversations. The real magic happens when you stop scanning what they said yesterday and start scanning what they've been saying for weeks.

That's why the Pattern Detection feature exists. It's not just another button—it's the entire reason the AI gets smarter over time. Upload 5+ conversations from the past month, and the algorithm stops looking for red flags and starts mapping the entire toxic ecosystem. It connects the love bombing in week one to the gaslighting in week three. It shows you the cycle, not just the symptoms.

Open the app right now and upload at least 5 different conversations from the past 30 days. Watch how the analysis transforms from 'concerning' to 'crystal clear.' The dashboard will show you patterns you literally couldn't see before. P.S. The 800+ users who avoided disaster? They all used Pattern Detection before making any big decisions. This is how you see what's really happening.
